title: optimization_history.json (v1.0)
description: Optimization process of one run, written by `run_optimization(progress="record")`: every new-best routing (frame) found by the optimizer plus the final applied result, and a bounded min/max envelope of all evaluated losses. Self-contained: `python -m routing_py_rebuild replay` renders it without the graph. Validated at write and read time.
$comment: Cross-field constraints JSON Schema cannot express (len(frames[].layers) == len(edges), layers in [0, L), edge endpoints have positions, evaluations.start/min/max aligned and start increasing from 1) are enforced by plotting/progress_figure.py::_validate_history.

edges.description: Edge order that frames[].layers / frames[].crossings are indexed by.

run.description: Free-form run metadata (optimizer, maxiter, seed, loss coefficients).

eval_index.description: 0-based loss_function evaluation index that produced this routing.

layers.description: Effective layer per edge (rounded, perimeter ring pinned).

crossings.description: Same-layer crossings per edge (equals Layer_i edge `crossings` in subgraphsdata.json for the final frame).

final.description: True only for the last frame when it is the result applied to the graph.

evaluations.description: Min/max loss of every evaluation, bucketed: bucket j covers the 1-based evaluation numbers start[j] .. start[j+1]-1 (the last one runs to count). Buckets are log-spaced (width 1 at first, doubling every `per_octave` buckets). null = no finite loss in the bucket.
